text.body: nīlakanṭhavāhanaṃ dviṣadbhujaṃ kirīṭinaṃ lolaratnakuṇḍalaprabhābhirāmaṣaṇmukham | śūlaśaktidaṇḍakukkuṭākṣamālikādharaṃ bālamīśvaraṃ kumāraśailavāsinaṃ bhaje || 1|| vallidevayānikāsamullasantamīśvaraṃ mallikādidivyapuṣpamālikāvirājitam | jhallarīninādaśaṅkhavādanapriyaṃ sadā pallavāruṇaṃ kumāraśailavāsinaṃ bhaje || 2|| ṣaḍānanaṃ kuṃkumaraktavarṇaṃ mahāmatiṃ divyamayūravāhanam | rudrasyasūnuṃ surasainyanāthaṃ guhaṃ sadā śaraṇamahaṃ bhaje || 3|| mayūrādirūḍhaṃ mahāvākyagūḍhaṃ manohāridehaṃ mahaccittageham | mahīdevadevaṃ mahāvedabhāvaṃ mahādevabālaṃ bhaje lokapālam || 4|| iti śrī subrahmaṇyastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
